title: Pinterest and IBM Just Struck Massive AI Deals. Amazon and Google Are the Big Winners.
title_zh: Pinterest 和 IBM 刚刚达成大规模人工智能交易。亚马逊和谷歌是大赢家。
summary: Amazon stock and Alphabet were gaining on Thursday as they announced AI deals, shrugging off concerns about the technology sector.
summary_zh: 亚马逊和 Alphabet 周四宣布人工智能交易，股价上涨，摆脱了对科技行业的担忧。

title: Target the Red-Hot Spin-Off and Merger Space With These ETFs
title_zh: 通过这些 ETF 瞄准炙手可热的分拆和合并空间
summary: Spin-offs and mergers can lead to major movement for share prices, but accessing these scenarios can be challenging for investors; these ETFs can help.
summary_zh: 分拆和合并可能会导致股价大幅波动，但了解这些情况对投资者来说可能具有挑战性；这些 ETF 可以提供帮助。

title: M&A Deals Thriving in 2025: ETFs in Focus
title_zh: 2025 年并购交易蓬勃发展：ETF 成为焦点
summary: M&A deals are booming in 2025 despite fewer transactions -- megadeals, AI bets and Fed cuts may fuel ETFs like MNA, IAI, KBWB & CHAT.
summary_zh: 尽管交易量减少，但 2025 年并购交易仍将蓬勃发展——大型交易、人工智能押注和美联储降息可能会推动 MNA、IAI、KBWB 和 CHAT 等 ETF 的发展。
